title: sdks: unify auth/retries, streaming parity and ergonomics; bump SDK versions to v1.41.0
author: Leah Park
ci_checks: go-unit-tests: pass (flaky on first run, rerun)
description: Motivation: SDK inconsistencies in auth headers, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics have caused subtle production bugs across hosted and private deployments. This PR consolidates auth middleware, aligns retry backoff and idempotency behaviors across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, brings streaming API parity (chunked server->client streaming surface and client-side cancelation hooks), improves developer ergonomics (simpler constructors, clearer error types), and performs a coordinated version bump to v1.41.0 across SDK packages. Changes summary: 1) Introduced unified auth middleware that normalizes token refresh, header precedence, and telemetry fields; 2) Standardized retry policy: max_retries, initial_backoff, backoff_multiplier, and idempotency classification now share the same config shape and defaults across languages; 3) Streaming parity: added server-stream iterator helpers for Python, readable stream adapters for TypeScript, and context/cancel-aware streams for Go; 4) Ergonomics: simplified SDK client constructors, added typed errors (AuthError, RetryLimitExceeded), and improved docstrings/jsdoc; 5) Tests & CI: added cross-language integration tests for streaming cancellation and retry on transient 502s; 6) Version bumps and changelogs updated. Checklist: - [x] design review - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] updated docs & changelogs - [x] release notes prepared. Impact: backward-compatible for most users; some advanced users who implemented custom retry wrappers should validate but default behavior is maintained.
